# SPDX-License-Identifier: CC0-1.0
# Authored analytical fixture; no third-party coordinate dataset is copied.
# FCC aluminium, ideal conventional cell at approximately room temperature.
# a = 4.05 Angstrom is rounded; not a measured precision lattice parameter.
# Reference crystal prototype: https://aflow.org/p/A_cF4_225_a-001/
# Density reference: 4 * 26.9815384 g/mol / (N_A * a^3)
# gives 2697.806069499423 kg/m^3, using exact SI N_A = 6.02214076e23/mol.
# Test tolerances: relative 1e-12 for volume and 1e-10 for density.
data_al_fcc
_cell_length_a 4.05
_cell_length_b 4.05
_cell_length_c 4.05
_cell_angle_alpha 90
_cell_angle_beta 90
_cell_angle_gamma 90
_space_group_IT_number 225
_space_group_name_H-M_alt 'F m -3 m'
loop_
